data.name: Chandrakumar
data.gender_notes: Chandrakumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chandrakumar is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Moon-powered'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is personified by the god Chandrasekhar, who is considered the god of the night and the ruler of the stars. The name Chandrakumar is a tribute to this celestial deity and signifies the power and grace of the moon. The name Chandrakumar carries the meaning “Moon-powered” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandrakumar usually hope their child will grow to embody moon-powered and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the wisdom and grace of the moon.
data.etymology: Chandrakumar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon-powered.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chandrakumar total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Chandrakumar is a name that carries deep cultural roots in the Hindu tradition. The name is inspired by the moon, a significant celestial body in Hindu mythology. Theampaan (the crescent moon sign) is an auspicious symbol featured in Hindu temples and ceremonies. It is believed that the moon brings fertility, prosperity, and peace, and the name Chandrakumar represents these qualities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the moon represents purity, wisdom, and the cycle of birth and rebirth. The moon is also considered a symbol of the divine feminine, representing the mysteries and depths of the universe. Naming a child Chandrakumar pays homage to the moon deity and invokes the blessings of knowledge, inner wisdom, and spiritual growth. The name signifies the inner strength, grace, and enlightenment that one can achieve through a deep connection with the celestial energies.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chandrakumar: Moon-God's-son. A name infused with the wisdom and tranquility of the lunar deity, Chandrakumar embodies the balance of light and shadow, illumining the path to inner peace and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Chandrakumar Tatuskar was a Maratha king who ruled the princely state of Sangli from 1570 to 1610. He was known for his military prowess and his expansionist policies, which saw the growth of the Sangli state.

Chandrakumar Azad was a prominent Indian independence activist and a founding member of the Indian National Army during the Indian independence movement against British rule. He was born in 1898 in Meerut, United Provinces, and was executed by the British in 1947.
